attackers_goals: An attacker might modify account attributes to elevate privileges and get access to strong accounts in the domain.
description: Suspicious account attribute modification that matches that of another account.
investigative_actions: Check if any associated certificates were granted. Check if any login attempts were made by the impersonated accounts using certificates. Check if any Kerberos TGT tickets were generated by the impersonated accounts using certificates.

required_data: XDR Agent with eXtended Threat Hunting (XTH)
